savingsDecision.scenarioText: You earned €6 allowance this week. In the shop you see a toy and a book you both really like. You only have enough for one of them.

piggyBank.intro: Every week you can put a few coins in your piggy bank. Watch how the money grows little by little!
piggyBank.outro: See that? Saving a little at a time, with patience, turns into a lot of saved money!

discountAds.explanation: The 'old' price of €40 was made up to look like a huge discount. But in other shops this scooter always costs €20 — you're not really saving anything!
This discount is real: the book really used to cost €10 and now it's €7. You're saving €3 for real!
70% off sounds amazing, but the 'always' price of €60 is made up. This model always costs around €18 in any shop.
This puzzle really has cost €15 for the last few weeks and is now €12. That's a real €3 discount.

interestExample.intro: When you put money in the bank, sometimes the bank gives you a bit more for leaving it there. That's called interest.
interestExample.explanation: If you put €10 in the bank and it gives you €1 more each year, after 1 year you have €11. After 2 years you have €12. Your money grows on its own while it's saved!

safety.scenario: Someone you met online asks you for your parents' bank card number.
safety.explanation: Ask an adult for help! The card number is secret and never gets shared with strangers, even online.

safety.scenario: You want to buy something in an online shop, so you ask an adult to help before paying.
safety.explanation: Great! Asking an adult for help before buying online protects you from being tricked.

safety.scenario: You get a message 'YOU WON A PRIZE! Send your card details now to receive it' and you go to send them.
safety.explanation: Ask an adult for help! Prizes that ask for card details are almost always scams — never send that information.

safety.scenario: The card PIN code is known only by you and your parents.
safety.explanation: Great! The PIN is a secret that only your trusted family should know.

safety.scenario: A friend from school asks for your parents' card PIN 'just to try it' and you tell them.
safety.explanation: Ask an adult for help! Never share the PIN with anyone, not even friends.

safety.scenario: A trusted adult is beside you while you shop online together.
safety.explanation: Perfect! Shopping online with a trusted adult nearby is the safest way.

safety.scenario: A message says 'PAY NOW or you lose your account!' and you pay quickly without asking anyone.
safety.explanation: Ask an adult for help! Messages that rush you are usually scams. Always ask before paying.

safety.scenario: You see an amazing free-money offer and ask an adult if it's real before believing it.
safety.explanation: Very smart! Offers that seem too good to be true usually are. Asking first protects you.
